customer: hey so im selling my electric car to northwind before i move to North Carolina for a new job, do i still need to pay the loan this month?? kinda tight on money with the move and dont wanna pay twice
agent: Yes, please keep making your regular loan payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off. Our payoff covers the amount your lender quoted, and a missed payment in the meantime can be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, your lender will refund it to you, and you can find more on that in our article "Getting back an extra loan payment."
